title: Plural of Moose: Is It "Meese"? #shorts
description:
What is the plural of moose? Your friend says, "One moose, two meese."
• One moose → two moose: moose is the same in the singular and the plural
• One goose → two geese: an old plural (the vowel changes)
• One mouse → two mice: the vowel changes, like in goose

So, who's going to tell your friend?

Clip: Two Tars (1928)
